row.text:
Once there was a swan who was very different than the other swans. He had big bright feathers, but he never talked like the other swans. He was very sad and stayed alone.

One day, a little girl saw the swan. It looked so lonely, so the little girl decided to comfort it. She brought it some food and sang it a special song.

The swan was so happy to have a friend! He waggled his feathers and started to eat. The little girl smiled and stroked the swan's feathers.

The little girl went back to see the swan every day, bringing it food and singing her special song. The swan was so happy to have a friend that it stopped feeling so alone and different. 

The little girl and the swan were the best of friends and the little girl comforted the swan every day.

Once there was a happy little girl. Her name was Jenny and she loved to watch the birds in the sky. Every morning she would go outside with her mother and they would talk, watch the birds, and pick flowers.

One day, Jenny went outside and noticed something strange. She saw a thief trying to steal her mother's flowers. Jenny was so scared, she ran back inside and told her mother.

Her mother smiled and said, "It's ok my Jenny. We will own these flowers and nobody will ever be able to take them away." She looked around and saw some other gardens with flowers too. Then she said, "Let's pick some from those gardens and we will own those too."

So Jenny and her mother went around to all the gardens and picked some of the flowers. They brought them back to the house and everyone was so happy. Jenny's mum had enough flowers to share with everyone in the neighbourhood.

The thief never tried to steal any more flowers from the neighbourhood again. Jenny and her mother owned all the flowers and everyone was happy.

Once upon a time there was a little fish who wanted to come and see the world. But the world was a big and difficult place and he was scared to come. Every night he would look at the stars, dreaming of what it could be like outside the pond.

Then one day his best friend the bee came over and told him the news. He said that if the little fish came with him, he could show him the beautiful world outside their pond.

The little fish was so excited that he swam as fast as he could to come with the bee. When he came to the top of the water, he saw a world that was so much bigger than his pond! There were trees, and clouds and even other fish!

Little Fish was so happy that he wanted to stay forever. He thanked his best friend the bee and promised to come back and visit often.

The little fish still comes back to visit his pond, but now he knows that the world is a special and beautiful place. And he will never forget how difficult it was to make the journey out of the pond.

Once upon a time there was a jolly little girl. She had pretty green eyes that liked to blink a lot. One day her mama said, â€œWeâ€™re going to the university today!â€ The little girl was excited and couldnâ€™t wait.

When they arrived, she looked around with wide eyes. Everything was so big and new! She saw so many things her little mind just couldnâ€™t believe. Every time she blinked, something new was there.

The little girl ran around almost everywhere, she was so happy. She followed her mama and asked a lot of questions. At the end of the day she looked up at her mama and said, â€œMama, can we go to the university again?â€ And her mama said, â€œYes!â€

One day, a little boy named Jack went out to the woods to explore. He was so excited; he hadn't ever been to the woods before!

He was walking and looking around when he noticed something strange. He saw a big barrel and he thought it was weird. He walked up to it and touched it. Suddenly, he heard a big sigh!

Jack wondered what made the sigh. He was so curious. As he got closer and looked inside the barrel he saw a creature.
Jack was so surprised! He never seen something like it before. It was weird.

The creature asked Jack if he wanted to play. Jack was a little scared but was excited too. He said yes and they both giggled and had lots of fun playing together.

Jack promised he will come back soon and they said their goodbyes. Jack promised he would never forget his new friend in the weird barrel.

Once upon a time, there was a apple tree. Every day, the tree would make delicious, original apples. One day, a little bunny hopped over to the tree. He saw all the apples and wanted to taste one. He jumped up and grabbed a big, juicy one with his leg.

The bunny took a bite and it tasted so sweet! He enjoyed every single bite until there was nothing left. The bunny was so happy, he hopped away with a smile on his face.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a big machine. It was the most important thing in the world and it kept everyone safe. One day, the people who used the machine lost it. They looked and looked but they couldn't find it. 

They were very unhappy and didn't know what to do so they asked their friends for help. One friend had an idea to make a new machine to keep everyone safe. Everyone was excited and started building the machine together. 

Finally, after a lot of hard work, the new machine was finished. Everyone cheered and the people were so happy to have a safe machine that would keep them safe again. Everyone congratulated each other for their hard work and celebrated with a big party. 

The End.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very frightened. She heard scary noises and was scared of being alone. When she saw it was dark outside, she quickly ran back into her house.

Inside the house, the little girl searched for her mum but couldn't find her. She was very sad, but she knew she must make a plan. She ran to her bedroom and decided to take a nap.

The little girl fell asleep, but then suddenly heard a loud noise. She was so scared that she hid under the bed. When she looked outside the window, she saw a fire! She knew someone must save her!

Luckily, a friendly fire fighter was there and he put out the fire. He saved the little girl from the flames and brought her back to her mum. They were both very happy and hugged each other.

From then on, they always stayed together so the little girl never had to be scared again.

Once upon a time, there was a gentle spider. She liked to explore the world around her. One day, when she was out on a stroll, she passed by a tree. She asked herself a question. "What might be up in the tree?" She wanted to find out.

So she started to climb. She climbed and climbed, higher and higher. Eventually she reached the top of the tree. She was so excited!

At the top, the gentle spider noticed the most amazing view! She was so happy that she had asked her question. She stayed a while and enjoyed the beautiful sight.

Then she smiled, and slowly climbed back down the tree. She could now answer the question she had asked. The gentle spider was very proud!

Once upon a time there was a cat called Pat. Pat lived in a big home with his mom and dad. He liked playing with his toys and exploring the house. 

One day, Pat wanted to go outside to play. His mom said he had to stay at home and ignore the things outside. Pat felt sad, but he obeyed his mom. 

So, Pat stayed at home and played with his toys. But he kept looking out the window and wanting to go outside. His mom noticed and bought him a new toy to keep him busy. It was a big truck, and it was very cheap. 

Pat loved his new toy truck! He played with it all day. Soon he forgot all about going outside and was happy staying at home. He and his mom smiled at each other. Pat had learnt his lesson and now always ignores the things outside and is happy playing with his toys at home.

Once, there was a girl who liked to perform. She could do many tricks and was very fast. She wanted to learn a new trick.

One day, she saw a square on the ground and decided to use it to perform. She tried it over and over, making it fast every time.

Finally, she did it! She had mastered the square. Everyone cheered and clapped for her. The girl felt very proud of herself.

She continued to perform her trick over and over. She got faster and faster each time. Soon, the girl was an expert at performing the square.

The girl was very happy that she had learnt a new trick. She smiled with joy and felt excited to show everyone her new skill.

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She had the most reliable toy car in the world. One day, she decided to take it for a drive. She drove and drove until she saw a big blueberry bush. She knew she wanted to eat the blueberries, so she parked her car and went closer to have a look. Suddenly, something amazing happened. Hundreds of little blueberries were ripe, just waiting to be picked. She was so excited that she filled her pockets with the blueberries before getting back in her car and driving away. The girl was so happy with her reliable toy car for taking her to the special blueberry bush!

Mama was in the kitchen making a new meal. She had all the ingredients mixed together in a pot. They were spicy. She opened the pot and added some soap. Then she stirred it all together and closed the lid.

The soup smelled delicious! Mama put a big bowl on the table and the family gathered around to enjoy it. They all ate it with big spoons. The soup was nice and hot and a little spicy.

When everyone had finished eating, Mama filled the bowl with warm soapy water. She passed it around the table and everyone took turns washing their spoons.

When they had all rinsed their spoons off, Mama closed the bowl and put it away. Everyone praised her for her delicious spicy soup. The family all had a special moment and smiled.

Once upon a time there was a kid who loved to unpack. One day, the kid was so excited that they ran outside in their garden. When they stepped out, they felt surprised! It was cold and icy! The kid looked around, and noticed all the boxes that had been delivered. They were full of toys and treats.

The kid quickly ran towards the boxes, and started unpacking. One by one, they pulled out all the things from the boxes. Their eyes sparkled as they found each new toy. They found cars, and dolls, and a big stuffed bear.
 
The kid danced around in the cold icy air, laughed, and jumped around. They were so happy! After all the boxes had been unpacked, the kid slept soundly, dreaming of all their new toys. 

The end.

One day, a little girl found something perfect in the ground. It was a shiny, silver tap. She was so happy and couldn't believe her luck. She wanted to keep it, so she took a big spoon and dug a hole in the ground. She put the tap inside and then filled the hole back up. She called it "burying the tap". 

The little girl was very proud of herself. She had buried the tap all by herself, and it was so perfect. She had kept it safe and nobody else could have it. She ran back home to tell her mommy and daddy all about it.

The next day, the girl went back to the spot where she had buried the tap. To her surprise, the tap was gone. Where could it have gone? She looked and looked but couldn't find it anywhere. She was very sad, but then realized that this was part of the game of burying the tap. She was glad that she had buried it so that it could find a new home.

Once upon a time, there was a happy little rabbit called Fluffy. He lived in the woods on a bright, sunny day.

Fluffy loved to dance. He would hop around, spin and twirl and jump in the air. Everyone in the woods thought he was so funny, watching him dance and showing off his moves.

But one day, Fluffy was feeling a bit uncomfortable. He couldn't get his dance just right and he didn't feel happy like he usually did.

So, he decided to take a break. He found a nice, quiet spot in the woods and curled up to have a nap. Suddenly, as he was dozing off, he heard a strange sound! It was a tune and it was coming from nearby.

Fluffy hopped out of his resting spot and followed the music. As he got closer, he saw something amazing! There was a group of other rabbits dancing together!

Fluffy couldn't believe his eyes. He wanted to join in and dance with the others. So, he put on a brave face and joined the fun. He found he was able to do all the moves with the others and had a great time.

The other rabbits were so happy to have Fluffy join them and he never felt uncomfortable again. From then on, every time the sun shone, Fluffy and his new friends would dance in the woods together, having the best time ever!

One day, a little child was walking in the park and came across another child. The other child was very bossy and kept telling the first child what to do. The first child didn't like this very much. So they kicked the bossy child and ran away.

The bossy child chased after the first child, but the first child was faster. They ran and ran and eventually stopped in a grassy field. When the bossy child caught up, the first child was ready. They kicked again and the bossy child ran away!

The first child was happy, but then they heard a cooing sound. It was a baby bird! The first child carefully kicked the ground in front of it, and the little bird flew away out of the field. 

The child watched it go, feeling glad they had helped. They felt proud and ready to do more good deeds. 

The end.

Little Jack was walking down the street. He saw a big, modern building and he thought it was so cool. He wished he lived there. But then he saw a group of people. Jack didn't like them; he hated the way they looked. He was scared, so he ran away. 

When Jack got to the end of the street, he felt much better. He looked around and he saw a big park. There were trees and swings, and it was so much nicer than the modern building. Jack knew it was a safe place, so he decided to stay and play. 

Jack spent the whole afternoon playing games in the park. He forgot all about the people he had seen and the thing he hated. All was well.

It was a gloomy day. Billy wanted to park his car. He opened the door, and he saw a pillow by the side of the street. He got out of his car and picked up the pillow. It was so soft and fluffy! Billy decided he wanted to park in the grass. So he grabbed the pillow and laid it in the grass. He put the car on top of the pillow. It felt so comfy and it gave him an idea. He laid down on the pillow for a nap. He felt so comfy, he fell asleep.

When he woke up, the sun was shining and the sky was blue. It was no longer gloomy! He looked around, his car was still parked on the pillow. Billy smiled and hopped in his car. He drove away with a happy heart.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Kate. She was playing in the park with her toy soldier. She loved to pull it around and make it walk like a real soldier.

But then one day, a big dark cloud came and filled the park with rain. Kate felt uncomfortable and so she started to pull her toy soldier towards her house.

On the way, she saw a real soldier walking in the rain. He was wearing a big hat, shiny boots, and a long coat. Kate stopped and looked at him.

The soldier smiled and said, â€œHi there! Donâ€™t feel uncomfortable in the rain. You can always find a way home.â€

Kate smiled back and nodded. She kept on pulling her toy soldier and soon she was back home.

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a nosy little girl. She loved to explore different places. One day, she was at the library and saw an icicle melting. She got excited and decided to put her hands out to catch the drops of water. As the icicle melted, one drop after another went into her hands. The nosy little girl was so excited to see the liquid that she wanted to play with the melting drops all day. Suddenly, the library opened and she had to go inside. But, she took a piece of the icicle home with her. As she looked at it, she imagined the icicle melting all over her hands again.

Once upon a time there was a chubby little lab. He was so happy and playful that he liked to stay in his lab all day. It was so much fun for him to stay there, he would look around and explore. He found lots of exciting things to explore and play with.

One day he found a big box filled with soft, furry toys. He stayed in the box for hours, playing and cuddling the toys. He knew this was the place for him to stay and explore. He liked the feeling of being safe and happy.

The lab enjoyed staying in his lab every day. He would run around and explore. He would look for something new and always have lots of fun. He even ate chubby treats in his lab so he could stay happy and healthy.

The lab had so much fun playing and staying in his lab every day. He loved the feeling of being safe, happy and having fun. He knew he would never want to leave his lab. He would always stay if he could.

Once there was a very special little girl named Lisa. She had a unique drawer in her room that was filled with fun surprises. 

One day, Lisa was looking through the drawer and came across an old torn piece of paper. She pulled it out and was excited to see a drawing on it. 

She used her crayons and coloured in the lines of the drawing, adding her own unique touches. When she was finished, she hugged the drawing and put it back in the drawer. 

The next day, she had a surprise for her family. She took out the drawing and handed it to her mom. Mom was so surprised to see the beautiful drawing.

Lisa had brought a unique tear to the drawing and it was now a one-of-a-kind work of art! Everyone was so proud of Lisa, and they all agreed that her drawing was the best one in the drawer, and the most unique one of all.

Sam was getting ready to go to school. He opened his drawer and took out his blue shirt. He quickly put it on and looked in the mirror. He looked organized and smart.

But when he went to school his friends started to laugh. He didn't understand why. He was embarrassed. Then he realized his shirt was on inside-out!

Sam quickly turned it around. He was so embarrassed but he felt better when his friends stopped laughing. He knew it was important to always be organized so this wouldn't happen again. He put the shirt back in his drawer and made sure it was correctly facing forward. 

With his shirt now on the right way around, Sam was ready to start a great day at school.

Once upon a time, there was a bell. Every morning it lifted everyone out of bed with its cheerful sound. Everyone in the village was so enthusiastic to get up and enjoy the day.

One day, a three year old boy decided he wanted to lift the bell too. He rushed outside and took hold of it. He was so proud that he had managed to do it.

The villagers were impressed by the little boy's enthusiasm. They cheered him on and clapped their hands.

The boy was delighted. Every morning from that day forward, he was the first one to lift the bell and let everyone know it was time to start the day!

Once upon a time there was a little boy. He was curious and wanted to explore the world around him. Every day he would look for something new to discover.

One day he went on a walk and found something strange. He discovered a large pile of waste! He was sad to see so much stuff thrown away.

The little boy decided to do something. He had an idea; maybe he could help clean up the waste.

He asked his friends if they wanted to help and they said yes! Together they worked and cleaned up the waste. They took turns carrying the stupid things away until it was all gone.

The little boy was proud of himself. He felt good knowing that he had made a difference. He had discovered a way to help the world and make it a better place.

A girl was at the beach with her family. She could see a big boat in the distance. The boat looked delicate and it was so pretty. The girl wondered what it would be like to sail in a boat like that.

With her familyâ€™s permission, she went to the beach every day after that. She watched the boat. It sailed across the ocean, over the waves. The girl was fascinated by it.

One day, the boat came close to the beach. The girl was so excited! She waved to the sailors and smiled at them. The sailors showed her how the boat sailed across the water. She learned all about the boat and the places it sailed to.

At the end of each day, the girl said goodbye to her new friends. She was so sad to see them go, but happy that she had seen them. The girl was so happy that she had found her own delicate boat.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who wanted to escape. She was feeling very sad, so she decided to run away.

The little girl came to a big oak tree with a broken branch. She thought that maybe she could escape by climbing up the broken branch. The little girl was scared, but brave too. She grabbed onto the broken branch, and started to climb.

The little girl was scared, but also excited. She kept climbing until she was at the very top of the oak tree. The little girl cheered when she reached the top!

She had escaped! The little girl looked out over the horizon, and knew that everything would be alright.

Once upon a time there was a small mouse who loved to zip around. She loved to explore the world and find new things. While she was out exploring one day, she noticed something very unusual. It was the strangest question she had ever seen. It made her pause and stand very still. She held her breath and looked around for the answer. Everywhere she looked, she couldn't find it.

Suddenly, something small zipped past her. It was a tiny bee. She giggled at the fast bee and followed him. He zipped around all different places and before she knew it, he had stopped right in front of the question! He had the answer. She smiled and thanked the bee as he flew away, and then she answered the strange question.

It was the best day ever! The small mouse had solved the mystery. She was so happy and proud of herself. She knew that the answer would make all her friends happy. As she zipped away, she was already excited to tell them what she had learned.

Peter was a mischievous 3 year old who liked to explore. One day, he stumbled upon a special cave. He was so curious and couldn't help but explore it. As he went deeper and deeper into the cave, he noticed something shiny and said, "Mine!" He ran towards the shiny object but then heard an eerie scream coming from deep inside the cave. He was scared and miserable and ran out of the cave as fast as he could. When he started to feel safe again, he knew he had learned his lesson to never go by scary caves again.

Once upon a time there was a small girl named Mimi. Mimi was very brave and she wanted to do fun things.

One day, Mimi dared to join a club. It was called the Adventure Club. All the kids in the club loved to do daring things.

Mimi was so excited to try new things! She tried new foods, swung from vines and met animals. It was so much fun!

The best part was that Mimi made lots of cute friends. They all looked after each other and cheered each other on.

Mimi had some amazing adventures with her friends and will never forget them. She loved the Adventure Club and all of the daring things they did.

Once there was a boy named Brian. He was three years old and he loved going to the park. Every day he would wear his favourite blue shoes. 

At the park Brian would explore and look for interesting things. One day he came across something special in one of the bushes. It was a golden key!

He knew the key must have been for something special, so he decided to find out what it opened. He looked around the park until he found an exit with a big wooden door. With his key, Brian opened the door and something extraordinary happened! 

Behind the door was a secret garden full of magical creatures and plants! Brian was so happy and excited! He ran around and played with the creatures and picked some beautiful flowers. 

Finally it was the time to go. Brian put the key back in the bush, said goodbye to the magical creatures and put on his shoes. He left the secret garden, feeling happy and full of joy.

Once upon a time there was a little girl called Lola. She was very curious about the world around her. One day, her mum and dad decided to get a tutor for Lola so she could learn about different things. 

The tutor was called Mrs Smith and she was very kind and gentle. She arrived with lots of delicate books and paper. Mrs Smith helped Lola to sit down and started to explain everything. 

At first, the pages looked like chicken scratches to Lola, but Mrs Smith said the words very clearly and slowly. She first explained about shapes, then letters and numbers. Lola listened carefully and soon became very good at understanding what Mrs Smith told her. 

Mrs Smith was very pleased with Lola's progress and each time she came, she brought something new to explain. Lola learnt lots because of her tutor and she soon became very clever. 

The End

Once there was a child who was very persistent. Everywhere she went she would try her best to make people laugh by telling jokes. One day she went to the park with her family and ran around telling jokes to anyone who would listen. 

The child never got tired of telling jokes. Even when people didnâ€™t laugh she kept trying to make them smile. Everyone she passed was happy to hear her jokes and even though sometimes it wasnâ€™t funny, they were impressed by her persistent nature. 

After a while, the child had gotten so good at telling jokes, that people were soon coming from other parts of the park to listen to her funny stories. People would smile and laugh and even the adults would be amazed by her ability to make them smile. 

By the end of the day, everyone in the park was happy and roaring with laughter, thanks to the child and her contagious jokes. She felt proud that her efforts had made so many people smile.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lila. She was very brave and liked to explore.

One day, Lila went on an adventure in the woods. She saw a cabin, so she decided to go near it. Whenever she got to the cabin, she saw a dragon!

The dragon was big and scary, but Lila didn't run away. She stayed calm and said hello to the dragon. The dragon wasn't mean, he was friendly! He asked her if she wanted to play with him.

Lila agreed and the dragon said to pinch his tail. She did, and it was very fun! They played together until it was time for Lila to go home. The dragon said goodbye and Lila thanked him for being so calm.

Lila ran happily back home, excited about her new adventure. She never expected to meet a dragon!

Once upon a time there was a brilliant place. It was full of beautiful colors and gorgeous sights. Every day people came to the place to have fun and explore.

One day something amazing happened. A magical secret was revealed. Everyone was so excited. They all had to find out what the secret was.

They looked in mysterious caves and went on long walks. But still the secret stayed hidden. They just couldn't find it.

Eventually, they found a hidden doorway. Behind the door was a brilliant surprise! A beautiful rainbow was revealed. Everyone smiled and laughed as the colors lit up the sky.

The secret of the magical place had been revealed. It was a brilliant place to explore and to play. Everyone was so happy. They would never forget the magical surprise that was revealed that day.

Once upon a time, there was a raven. He was a big, black bird and he loved to pick the juiciest berries. One day he found the most delicious berry ever! He picked it carefully, as it was very fragile.

But as he flew away with his prize, a mischievous little boy saw him. He quickly reached out and tried to pick the berry away from the raven. But the raven was too fast. He flew higher and higher, out of the little boys reach.

The little boy was sad, but he was still determined. He didn't give up. He kept watching the sky for the raven, until he finally spotted him flying in the distance. He ran as fast as his little legs could go, trying to catch up. But the raven was too quick. In the end, the raven enjoyed his juicy berry all by himself.

Mama had a surprise for the children. Today they were going to take a test. The children were excited to take the exam because they had been practicing hard.

Mama showed the children a special paper. On the paper, there were many questions. Some of the questions were easy but some were very hard. The children did their best to answer the questions.

When they were finished, Mama smiled. She said that everyone did a great job. She reminded them that it is important to always stay curious and practice to become better at something.

Mama said that those who are ignorant don't take the time to test themselves. She wanted the children to understand the importance of learning and growing. She told them to always take the time to test their skills.

The children thought about what Mama said and smiled. They were happy to have taken the exam because it was fun to learn.

Once upon a time there was a yellow box. It was an unusual box because it had no lid. Every day the same thing happened; the box would open on its own. One day, a little boy stopped to look at the box. He was curious as to why it always opened by itself. He got closer to the box and stuck out his hand to see if it would open again. Sure enough, the box opened and the little boy was so surprised! Inside the box was a bright yellow present with his name on it! He opened the present to find that it was full of delicious candy! The little boy was so happy that the box had opened and he was overjoyed that he had found the special present inside. He thanked the box for its unusual behavior, took his gift and went on his way, with a very big smile on his face.

One day, a little girl was worried about going to school. She didn't want to go, and she didn't want to do any of her work. She was scared and sad, so she shut the door to her bedroom and stayed inside.

Her mom and dad came to talk to her, but the little girl wasn't ready to talk. She kept her door shut. But her mom and dad had an opinion, and they asked the little girl to open the door so they could talk.

The little girl was still worried, but she opened the door. And when she opened the door, she listened to her mom and dad's opinion. She was surprised to hear their opinion, and it made her feel better. She wasn't scared anymore. She smiled, shut the door, and was ready to face the day.

Once there was a girl named Kaitlyn who wanted to play with her silver marker. But it was missing! Kaitlyn looked everywhere but still couldn't find it.

She became very frustrated and cried loudly. She asked her mom to help her find the silver marker. Her mom looked in every corner of the house, but there was no sign of the marker. 

Kaitlyn's mom then had an idea. She took Kaitlyn to the store to get a new marker. Kaitlyn was so excited when she saw so many silver markers at the store. She couldn't choose which was the prettiest.

In the end, Kaitlyn picked a sparkly, silver marker. She couldn't wait to start using it. She immediately went home and started to draw on the walls. Kaitlyn made beautiful art and was very proud of her silver marker.

Little Tommy was a chubby three year old who loved cocoa. Every morning, he would beg his mommy for some cocoa and drink it while watching his favorite cartoon. 

One day, Tommy was so excited that he finished his cocoa even faster than usual. He asked his mommy for more, but she said it was time to stretch. 

Tommy didn't understand. What did stretching have to do with cocoa? He wrinkled his nose in confusion. 

His mommy put a hand on his shoulder and smiled. She said to him, "Stretching is good for you, Tommy. It helps your body to stay strong, just like cocoa helps your brain to stay healthy!" 

Tommy's face lit up. He realized that stretching was almost like a kind of cocoa for your body! He smiled and nodded eagerly. 

So from then on, every morning after drinking his cocoa, he would follow his mommy's lead and stretch. Little Tommy never forgot the importance of stretching and cocoa!

Once upon a time, there was a purple train. It went all around the world, and it was so much fun.

The train had flowers and clouds and trees, and a pink whistle. It made the nicest sound, like a song.

One day, a little girl was riding on the train. She had a nice lollipop and she was chewing it with her teeth. The lollipop was so yummy and sweet.

But then, the train went faster and faster, and she dropped her lollipop! It flew out the window and away it went.

The little girl was sad and she cried. But then, she put on a smile and said, "It's okay, I'll get another lollipop someday."

Once upon a time, there was a rich man. He had lots of nice things. 

One day, he wanted a new hedge in his garden. He asked for everyone to come and help build it. 

But the day was sunny, and everyone was enjoying the weather. They all delayed helping the rich man.

So the man decided to do it on his own. He worked very hard, and he managed to build a big and beautiful hedge.

The rich man was very happy with his hedge. All his friends admired it, and they were sorry they had delayed helping him. 

The end.

Once there was a humble bird. This bird wanted to fly very high. One day, the bird flapped its wings and soared up, up and away. The bird felt so free as it flew! 

Suddenly, the bird realized it only had one problem - it had no gas. Without gas, it wouldn't be able to keep soaring. The bird looked around to find some, but couldn't see any. 

Just then, the bird heard a friendly voice. It was a friendly bee. The bee said that it had lots of gas and would share it with the bird. The bird was so happy! 

The bee filled the bird's wings with gas. The bird thanked the bee and flew away. As it soared around, it had the biggest smile. The bird was so proud that it could fly so high and far, thanks to the bee's generous gift!

Tommy was playing in the sand. He forgot his bucket. He wanted to make a sandcastle but he didn't have a bucket. He felt sad.

Then, he saw a pretty blue egg in the sand. He picked it up and smiled. He quickly ran home with the egg so he could show his mom.

When Tommy got inside, he found his mom. She was feeling jealous because his dad had bought a new toy for his sister.

Tommy showed his mom the egg and said "Look Mommy! I found a special egg!". His mom smiled and hugged him. She suddenly felt better. Tommy was happy that he could make his mom feel better.

They put the egg in a bowl on the kitchen table. Tommy and his mom looked at the egg and smiled together. Tommy was glad that he didn't forget his egg.

Dan saw some bubbles while he was playing in the park. He ran over to them, determined to catch them. Suddenly, he tripped and spilled his soup, which made him sad. He started to cry, but then something unique happened.

A friendly lady grabbed a plastic bag and filled it up with bubbles. She said, "There you go! These are yours now." Dan was surprised, but excited.

He asked the lady, "Can I play with them?" She smiled and said, "Of course! You can do anything you want with them." Dan smiled and thanked her.

He ran around the park with the bag full of bubbles, popping them and making shapes with the air. It was a fun and unique game, and he was so happy to play with it.

Once upon a time there was a tired bear. The bear was so tired he had to take a nap. He found a big cap to attach to his head. Then he lay on a log and soon he was sound asleep! As the bear slept he dreamed of a happy place with lots of fun things to do. But soon the sun was rising and it was time for the bear to get up. He waited for the sun to reach high in the sky before removing his cap and getting off the log. The bear was happy and refreshed after his nap!

Once upon a time, there was a dinosaur. He was very big and he was very kind. He was a compassionate dinosaur.

One day, he saw a little girl. She looked sad and he wanted to help her. He asked her why she was so sad.

The little girl started to cry. She told him that she had lost her favourite bird. The dinosaur said he was sorry and asked her if there was anything he could do to help.

The little girl thought for a moment, then she had an idea. She mentioned that maybe they could look together. The dinosaur said that sounded like a good idea and they set off on their search.

After a while, they found the little girl's bird! The little girl was so happy and thanked the kind dinosaur. Then they both went on their way.

The dinosaur was very happy that he had been able to help. He felt proud and was reminded that it is important to be compassionate.

Once upon a time there was a skeleton. He was very polite and he liked to move around. He danced in the fields and skipped by the trees. He even moved inside some big, old houses! The skeleton moved all day. 

He was so polite that he said 'hello' and 'thank you' to everyone he came across. He heard them call him the 'polite skeleton' and he was so proud! 

One day he was walking down a big road and he came across a river. The skeleton moved to the other side and thought he would take a rest. He laid down by the river and closed his eyes for a nap. Suddenly, he felt something move around his feet! He opened his eyes and it was a little three year old child playing with him! 

The skeleton was so polite that he said 'hello' to the little boy and acted friendly. And from then on, the polite skeleton and the little three year old boy were the best of friends!

Once upon a time there was a girl and a boy. The girl was very kind, and she loved to give the boy lots of kisses.

The boy was old enough to talk, but he was still very cute. He liked it when the girl kissed his face, and so he asked for more.

The girl was so happy that the boy wanted her to kiss his face, but one day the boy said something mean and stupid.

The girl felt very sad, and she didn't know what to do. Then she thought it would be nice to give the boy one more kiss on his face, to show he was sorry.

So the girl leaned in close and gave the boy a big kiss on his face. The boy was so happy, he smiled and hugged her. 

The girl was glad she kissed him and everything was good again.

Jimmy loved to explore the desert near his house. One day, he took his mom's recorder and went off to find some new and exciting things! He was so excited to find a huge cactus with bright pink flowers! But Jimmy didn't know that the cactus was quite prickly and miserable. He wanted to record the cactus for his mom, but when he touched it he found out how miserable it was. He quickly put the recorder away and backed away from the cactus. He spent the rest of the day looking at beautiful rocks and plants until it was time to go home. He never forgot the miserable cactus!

Molly was a very independent girl. One day she went to the park. She saw a balance beam across the playground. She wanted to try it. 

She stepped up on one side of the beam and carefully balanced her way across. She was surprised at how good she was. 

But then she heard someone clapping. Molly looked down and saw a judge smiling at her. She was even more surprised. 

The judge said, "You did an excellent job balancing! You should enter the balance competition next week." 

Molly was really excited. She said she would definitely enter. She couldn't wait to show how independent and strong she was. 

The next week, she entered the competition. She balanced her way across the beam just like she did before. Everyone clapped and cheered. The judge was very pleased. He gave Molly a blue ribbon for being the best balancer in the competition. 

Molly was so proud of herself. She was happy she could balance so gracefully and independently. She was so proud that a judge noticed her skill and gave her a reward. 

From then on, Molly kept practicing her balancing. She was proud of how far she had come.

Once upon a time there was a girl called Lola who loved to play. She had lots of toys and furniture in her room. Lola liked to keep everything organized so she could find all of her things. 

One day, Lola wanted to play a new game. She got an idea, so she closed her eyes and jumped on the furniture. She pretended she was a superhero and had to save the world. 

Lola flew all around the room and then stopped at the bed. She shouted "dive" and jumped so high, she nearly touched the ceiling. Afterwards, she was so tired, she fell fast asleep. 

The next morning when Lola woke up, she couldn't believe what she saw. The furniture was all neatly organized! Maybe her superhero powers worked!

Once there was a wise old owl who loved to stitch. He had been stitching forever, and he was very good at it too! But now it was time to celebrate. 

So, the wise owl started to look for someone to join him. Everywhere he looked, he couldnâ€™t find anyone. He even asked the birds, bees, and bugs, but no one wanted to join him. 

The owl was getting very sad. Then, he looked up and saw some friends flying around. They cheered for the owl and said, â€œLetâ€™s celebrate!â€ 

The owl was so happy that he started to stitch with all of his friends around him. He stitched a quilt with beautiful colors and patterns. Everyone loved it! 

The owl smiled and said, â€œItâ€™s time to celebrate!â€ And everyone celebrated with music, dancing, and a big feast. It was the best celebration ever!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called John. John loved lollipops! One day John was looking for lollipops. He wanted to find a rare one. He looked and looked, but he could not find a rare lollipop. Finally, he saw a big lollipop hiding behind a rock. John was very excited! He picked up the lollipop and saw that it was rare. It was red, yellow and blue! John licked it and licked it until it was gone. He was very happy because he found the rare lollipop. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a tall lion. He lived in a big jungle with other animals. One day, the lion wanted to show off his strength.

He jumped as high as he could and then he landed on a tree. He thought he was very brave, but the tree broke!

The lion was not happy. He wanted to find something else to break and show how brave he was. But, he looked around and all he could find were other animals.

He couldn't break them, so the lion just sat down and smelled the flowers instead. The other animals were happy that the lion didn't break anything else.

There was a phone on the floor. It had been there for a long time and it was not doing anything. Suddenly, it began to move! It started to shake and move around really quickly. 

The phone was very alert. It kept on moving and shaking, even though nobody was telling it to move. It kept on going! 

Then, something very special happened. The phone stopped moving and started speaking a friendly voice. It was a friendly voice saying, "Hello! Is anybody there?". 

The little 3 year old was surprised. She had never seen a phone move around before. She answered the friendly voice and asked what was happening. 

The friendly voice explained that somebody was calling from far away. They wanted to wish the 3 year old a very happy day. Everyone was so excited! 

The 3 year old said goodbye to the friendly voice and the phone stopped moving again. She smiled and knew she could talk to her friend anytime she wanted. It was a very special day for the 3 year old and her new moving phone.

Once there was a small family. They were so excited, because it was holiday time. Every spring, they went on a very special holiday. 

First, they went to the beach. They built a sandcastle and had lots of fun. Then, they went on a boat ride. They waved to the fishes and watched the birds flying in the sky. 

When they were tired, they went back to their small house. They had dinner, laughed, and told stories together. 

At the end of the day, they all snuggled up in bed and went to sleep, dreaming about all the fun things they did on their holiday.

Once there was a little girl named Emily. She was very impatient and wanted to play chess with her brother. She went to the toy shop and was very happy when she saw the chess set. She showed it to her brother and they started to play.

Emily was winning the game but then something strange happened. All of a sudden, the pieces on the board started to disappear! Emily was so surprised. She looked around the room but the pieces were nowhere to be seen.

Emily got very upset. She wanted to finish playing the game but the pieces had all disappeared. She started to cry, but then her brother had a great idea. He told her that if they both closed their eyes and said a magic spell, the pieces would come back.

So they both closed their eyes and said the magic words. When they opened their eyes the pieces had reappeared! Emily was so happy that she hugged her brother and continued to play her game.

Once upon a time there was a cheerful skeleton. He lived in a big house and every day he would pretend. He had many fun things to pretend. 

One day he pretended he was a chef and cooked an imaginary meal. It was so good he pretended to eat it! Another time he pretended to be a pirate and sailed the big ocean. He had a fishing rod and a big hat. 

He also pretended to take care of animals. He gave them food, cleaned up after them and cuddled them. He felt very happy when he pretended to take care of them.

The cheerful skeleton was very busy as he had lots of things to pretend every day. But, he was very happy and always had a lot of fun. And he always ended his days feeling very content.

Once there was a bad man who wanted some water. He looked everywhere but he couldn't find any water. He was so angry he started to cry.

Then something special happened. A big white cloud appeared in the sky and filled the air with water. The water floated down from the sky and wrapped the bad man in a big hug. The water was so soft and comforting.

The bad man felt happy. He smiled for the first time in days. He jumped in the water and soaked up the sun. He swam in the water for hours and felt so clean and refreshed.

The bad man thanked the cloud for bringing the water and wrapped himself up in a big, warm towel. He no longer felt bad and went on his way feeling happy and refreshed.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful palace that everyone wanted to visit. Inside the palace lived a kind and friendly King. His subjects were very happy and content because the King was so generous.

One day, the King decided to raise a baby elephant. He loved the little elephant so much and every day he would spend hours taking care of it. Soon, the King's subjects became jealous of the attention that the King lavished on the baby elephant.

They grew even more jealous when the King decided to build a special palace for the elephant. It had the best beds, and the most delicious food. Everyone wanted to live in the palace, but the King made sure that only the elephant was able to enjoy its comforts.

The King and the elephant lived happily together in their palace, and everyone around them recognized that the King had made the right decision by raising the elephant.

Once there was a foolish rabbit who was always on the lookout for surprises. One day, he was hopping around in the grass when he spotted something shiny. He hopped closer and found that a big surprise was waiting for him- a big piece of meat! He couldn't believe it.

The rabbit had never seen meat so big before and he was so excited. He grabbed the meat and quickly started to munch it all up. He was so happy and couldn't believe his luck. 

But then the rabbit heard a loud noise. He looked up and saw a farmer coming towards him. The farmer was not happy about the rabbit eating his meat and he started to shout. The rabbit was so scared he quickly hopped away and never came back. 

The rabbit had been very foolish to trust such a surprise, but it taught him a valuable lesson- never trust anything that looks too good to be true!

Once upon a time, there was a purple spider. He lived in a cozy corner of the house. Every day, he would crawl around and explore.

One day, the purple spider went outside. He saw a big, bright light, and it was very beautiful. He ran towards the light and couldn't wait to explore it.

But when the purple spider got closer, he disappeared! He was gone and no one could find him. Everyone in the house was very sad, but they kept looking for him.

After a few days, the purple spider reappeared! He had been hidden in the light and was safe. Everyone was so happy to see him again.

The purple spider never disappeared again. He stayed in his cozy corner, and everyone was very happy knowing he was safe.

Once upon a time there was a very soft little bear. His name was Benny. He lived in a big, deep well with lots of other animals. Every morning he would call out to his friends as loud as he could, "Good morning!" His friends in the well would call back to him and they would all chat for a while. 

One morning, however, nobody answered Benny's call. He spent all morning calling out but still no one answered. Benny was starting to get worried. He called out one more time and this time he heard a soft voice answer, "Yes?" It was a little frog who had been hiding down at the bottom of the well.

The frog told Benny that the other animals had all gone away. Benny was very sad. He said goodbye to the little frog and started to climb out of the well. As he reached the top of the well, he realized that all the other animals had been waiting for him outside.

They had heard Benny's call and had come back to find him. They were all so happy to see Benny again and gave him big hugs. Benny was so happy to be back with his friends. They all hugged one more time and called out, together, "Good morning!"

Once upon a time, there was a small, fragile girl. She loved visiting the lake near her home. Every time she went, she could hear birds singing and the wind whistle. She loved to sit by the lake and watch the ducks swimming in the water.

One day, when she went to the lake, she brought her pocket whistle. She held onto it tightly and blew hard, making the most beautiful sound. The birds stopped singing and all the ducks turned to look at her. The girl felt so special and happy.

She kept blowing, and the ducks swam closer and closer. When they reached her, she put the whistle away and gave each one a piece of bread. The ducks were so happy! Every time she visited the lake after, they would come swimming to her, reminding her of that special day.

Once there was a puppy named Peanut who liked to play all the time. He loved to chase butterflies and find new things to explore. One day Peanut got sick and his mommy knew it was time to use a veterinarian.

Peanut's mommy drove him to the veterinarian's office. Peanut was a little scared but the doctor was very kind and peaceful. The doctor asked lots of questions and checked him all over. The doctor said that he needed to take some medicine and have lots of rest.

Peanut was so relieved. He thanked the veterinarian and said goodbye. He went home and took lots of naps. A week later, Peanut was all better and back to chasing butterflies and exploring. He was so happy to be feeling better and to be feeling peaceful.

Once upon a time there was a gloomy pepper. It was an unhappy pepper because no one ever paid any attention to it. Each day it would sit sadly in the corner of the garden. 

One day, a little girl come to the garden. She saw the pepper, and smiled. She went to the kitchen and came back with a bowl of water. She began to pour the water over the pepper. 

The pepper felt the water and was so happy! It was as if it was waking up again. Suddenly, the pepper sprouted colourful leaves! Everyone was so amazed! 

The little girl kept pouring water on the pepper and made sure it stayed happy. From that day on, the pepper was much brighter and everyone in the garden sang along with it.

Once there was a young girl named Daisy. She was 3 years old, and loved to laugh. Every day, Daisy would sing silly songs and jokes into her microphone. She thought it was so much fun!

One day Daisy's mom took her to a special park. She saw a stage with a big microphone on it! She was so excited, she ran right over to it. 

Once she got there, she grabbed the microphone and started singing. Then some other children saw Daisy and started to laugh. Soon everyone in the park was laughing at Daisy's funny songs. Daisy just laughed and laughed too. 

She and the other kids had so much fun that day. They all sang songs, put on a show and laughed together. Daisy was so happy she kept singing and laughing into the microphone. 

By the end of the day, everyone was smiling and all had such a great time. Daisy loves to laugh and loves her microphone!

One day, Therese was very bored. She was just three years old, but she already had a telephone. She decided to call her Grandma to see if she wanted to come and play.

When Grandma answered the telephone, she and Therese had a plan. They would both go to the park. There was a big tree there and they could play underneath it.

At the park, Therese found a big log. She wanted to climb it, but it was too hard. But then Grandma showed her how to be flexible. She showed Therese how to twist her body to fit over the log. Then, Therese could easily climb it.

When Therese made it to the top, she was so happy. She shouted, "Look at me! I did it!" Grandma clapped and cheered.

Before they left the park, they took a picture. Grandma snapped the picture with her phone and Theyse smiled big.

That day was so much fun. Now, whenever Therese gets bored, she looks at the picture of her and Grandma at the park and remembers how flexible she can be.

Once there was a successful dove. That dove was so very happy! One day the dove wanted to celebrate. So the dove flapped its wings and flew around in the air. It was so much fun! Then more doves came from far away and joined the celebration. They flew around and around together in the sky. Everyone was so happy and it felt like a magical time! Everyone was celebrating and being successful!

When the celebration was over the doves said goodbye to each other and flew away. But the first dove stayed and remembered the special day it had celebrated.

Once upon a time, there was a horse called Tony. Tony had a big heart he loved to share with everyone he met. One day Tony went for a walk and found himself in a big chamber. It was open and so he went in. Inside there was a giant lady with big hands. She gave Tony a hug and asked for his friendship. Tony said yes and the lady asked him to forgive her for something she had done. Tony was so kind he said yes and the lady was very happy. They stayed friends from then on. Tony had the biggest heart and always forgave people when they needed it.

One day, there was a brilliant bush. It was the most special ever! 

Jack was walking by and he loved it. He wanted to make it even more special, so he had an idea. He grabbed a stick and began to reverse around it, going backwards in circles.

He was spinning faster and faster, and was having so much fun! He was certainly not getting tired! 

The bush started to sparkle and glitter, it was so beautiful! Everyone stopped to admire it. Even the birds were impressed.
 
The bush was now even more brilliant than ever! Jack was very proud. He had been clever and done something amazing. Now, everyone could admire his masterpiece!

Once upon a time, there was a puppy who lived with a family. The puppy was happy, but one day there was a loud noise outside. The puppy was scared, so it ran and hid. The family looked outside and saw police. Suddenly, they all got very worried.

The police were looking for something. The family prayed that they would not find it. The puppy prayed too, even though it didn't know why.

The police found what they were looking for and left. Everyone was relieved and hugged their puppy. They all thanked God for keeping them safe.

The family learned that when we are scared, if we pray and have faith, everything will be okay. They all promised to pray whenever they were scared. The End.

Once there was a dog called Ginger. She was very obedient. Every day, her master would feed her some food. He would always give her delicious treats.

One day, Ginger's master raised the bowl of food and put it underground. Ginger didn't understand why he was doing this, but she was obedient, so she waited until her master came back.

When her master returned, he lifted the bowl out of the ground, and a surprise was inside. There were lots of juicy bones! Ginger was so happy that she jumped up and down with joy.

Ginger was so grateful that she showed her master how obedient she was. She licked his face with her tongue and thanked him for the delicious bones. From that day onward, every day she got a surprise when her master put the bowl underground.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Jack. He had a very special, original bow. Every day he would practice with his bow, because he wanted to become a great archer. But no matter how much he practiced, people around him seemed to ignore him. 

This made Jack sad, so he decided to go on a journey. He wanted to find someone who could appreciate his hard work and original bow. Jack traveled for many days, until he came across a great castle. He walked through the castle gates and saw lots of people in the castle courtyard. 

He was very surprised and excited when he saw a group of people watching him and clapping. It was the King and his courtiers! They had noticed Jack and his original bow and were very impressed. 

Jack felt relieved and happy. He knew that he had found a place where he would be appreciated, and he could practice and learn without being ignored. 

From that day on, Jack was able to practice archery and learn new skills, knowing that his hard work was valued and appreciated by the King and his courtiers.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to explore. One day, she decided to go on an adventure. But suddenly, she got stuck in the mud and could not move! 

Luckily, she saw a magical cross in the sky. It was so twinkly and beautiful! The girl looked at the cross and called out for help. 

Suddenly, a big knight appeared from the sky. He was so brave and strong! He asked the girl what was wrong and the girl told him about the mud. 

The knight jumped down and rescued the girl. He held her tight and carried her back to safety. 

The little girl was so happy to be safe. She gave the knight a big hug and thanked him for coming to her rescue. 

The knight smiled and flew away. The little girl was so happy that she had been rescued by the cross.

Once upon a time, there was a sunflower that was all alone. It was white and empty and it felt sad.

The sunflower wanted a friend, so it started to look around. Then it saw a caterpillar and the sunflower smiled.

The caterpillar was grey and fuzzy. They were so happy to see each other, they became best friends.

Every day they did fun things together. They jumped, they raced and they even sang songs.

But then one day the caterpillar started to rot. The sunflower was so sad to see its friend getting smaller, but it stayed and watched over it until all the rot was gone.

And when the sunflower opened its eyes, it saw that the caterpillar had turned into a beautiful butterfly with white wings.

The sunflower and the butterfly were so happy to be together again, they flew off into the sky to explore the world.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to play guitar. She would lay down on the grass beneath the big old tree and strum her guitar. She loved to make the happy sounds, though it was not always easy for her.

But one day, something magical happened. As the little girl lay with her guitar under the tree, a fairy sprinkled special sparkles on her. Suddenly, she could play her guitar as easily as she breathed! 

The little girl was so excited. She played and sang a beautiful song that filled the air with happiness. Even the birds stopped to listen! 

The fairy smiled and said, "As long as you practice, you can make your guitar sing melodies that everyone can enjoy".

And so the little girl continued to lay on the grass beneath the tree and make music with her guitar. It was easy now, and she felt happy and so proud of herself.

Sweety was a 3 year old girl who lived on a farm. Sometimes her mommy would give her a razor and show her how to use it. Sweety was always amazed and wondered what it was used for.

One day while she was outside, Sweety saw a cat in a big, tidy garden. She was curious so she wandered over to take a closer look. When Sweety was nearby, the cat hissed at her. She gasped in surprise and ran back towards her mom.

Sweety told her mom about the cat. Her mom smiled and said that the cat was probably just scared of the razor. She said that animals can smell stuff like that and become scared. Sweety thought about this and wondered why the cat was so scared of the razor. She soon decided that she would keep the razor far away from the cat and make sure to keep the garden tidy.

Once there was a bear who lived in a deep valley. He was very lonely and wanted a friend. One day, he found a rabbit in the valley and asked the rabbit to be his friend. But the rabbit refused. The bear was so sad. He tried asking other animals, but they all refused too. The bear was lonely and walked through the valley by himself. Suddenly, he heard a noise. The bear looked all around and discovered a new animal in the valley. It was a tiny mouse. The bear asked the mouse to be his friend. The mouse happily agreed. The bear and the mouse became very good friends and played together every day in the deep valley.

Once upon a time there was a popular secret. Everyone wanted to know what it was but no one knew. Some said it was a funny joke, others said it was a special treat. But no one had the secret. 

One day, a small girl was walking through the woods and she stumbled upon the secret. It was a small flower with a bright yellow center. She picked it and put it in her pocket. She was very excited about her find. 

That night she went to school and she told all of her friends about the secret. They were amazed that she could find the secret. She showed them the flower and everyone thought it was the most beautiful thing ever. 

The little girl shared the secret with all of her friends. Now it was a popular secret that everyone knew. They all agreed it was the best secret ever!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Ann who was so very charming. She lived a happy life until one day something exciting happened. She was playing in her room when she found something under her bed - it was a secret box!

Ann was so curious and wanted to know what was inside the box. She tried to open it, but it was locked. She looked around to see if there was a key, but she couldn't find one.

Suddenly, she had an idea. She jumped up and grabbed the handle and gave it a twirl. Miraculously, the box opened! Ann was filled with excitement. She opened the box to find some presents inside. She quickly put them away and decided to hide the box in her closet.

Ann felt so brave. The box was safe, and she was able to keep all the presents secret. Later that day when her mom asked her what she did, she just smiled and said she had a charming day.

Once upon a time there was an ancient village. Every year the village would raise a firework into the sky to celebrate an important day. 

The villagers were very excited to raise the firework this year. They followed their ritual and lit the firework in the evening sky. Everyone cheered and clapped as the firework soared in the sky, leaving a trail of beautiful sparkles. 

The firework sailed higher and higher. It lit up the night sky with a bright orange glow. The villagers cheered and applauded in awe. Before they knew it, the firework had disappeared into the darkness.

The villagers were glad they had been able to raise the firework each year. They knew it was a special act that would stay in their memories forever.

Jessie had a thin guitar. It made him happy to play it. Every day, he would strum the strings and pluck little tunes. One day, however, something strange happened. He felt a tickle in his nose. He paused his playing and then he sneezed! His guitar made a funny noise when he sneezed. He smiled and continued playing, with the guitar sounding slightly different after the sneeze. Jessie kept playing and eventually the strange sound went away. Jessie kept his guitar thin and kept playing delicious melodies every day.

Once upon a time, there was a princess who was very brave. She wanted to explore the world, so she set off on an adventure. On her journey, she came across a big, messy castle. She was a bit scared, but then she saw a friendly face peeking out of the window - it was a dragon!

The princess was frightened, but she nodded her head. They worked together to clean up the mess, and bit by bit the castle became shiny and sparkly. The dragon felt better, and the princess was happy.

She thanked the dragon for helping her on her adventure and set off on the next leg of her journey. She remembered the lessons she had learnt from the dragon, and with a nod of her head, she was off!

Once upon a time, there was a small boy named Ted. He was three years old and he was very curious. One day, he asked his mom to keep a special promise. His mom said, "Sure! I'll keep this promise." Ted was so glad. He smiled and hugged his mom.

The promise was to take him to the park the next day. Ted knew that his mom never broke her promises, so he was very excited. The next day they went to the park and Ted was filled with joy. He played with his friends and he ran around. He made some new friends too!

At the end of the day, Ted's mom asked him if he had a good day. He said yes and gave her a big hug. He was so glad to have a mom who kept her promises. He knew that he could always count on her. Ted and his mom kept their special promise together and it filled their hearts with joy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Jazz. She loved to walk everywhere she went. One day, Jazz decided to take a walk in the woods. As she walked, she saw something dangerous. She was scared and wanted to go home but was too scared to move. Suddenly she heard some music. It was coming from a clearing in the woods. As she listened, she realized it was jazz music! She followed the music and found a group of animals playing instruments and dancing to jazz music. She was so surprised that she forgot she was scared of the dangerous thing in the woods. When the music stopped, Jazz thanked the animals and said goodbye. She walked safely home, feeling happy that she had found such a fun adventure.

Once upon a time there was a little train. It was bright red and made of metal. The train was very fast and liked to zip around the track. 

One day the little train saw a big stadium. The stadium was made of thick stone and it was very big. The little train was so excited to see it. 

The little train pulled up to the entrance of the stadium and started to zip around it. It went around and around the thick stone walls. Everyone was so happy to see the little train running around the track. 

The little train had so much fun running around the stadium. Everyone was smiling and waving. Finally, the train was tired and stopped. It happily made its way back home.

The end.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Sarah. She loved to play in the park. One day she was playing in the park, when she saw a fairy! The fairy was small and twinkly with a pretty dress on. She was very charming. 

The fairy waved her magic wand and said â€œI will lead you on a magical adventure!â€ Sarah was so excited! The fairy lead Sarah to a big tree in the park. On the tree was all sorts of lovely pick. There were apples, oranges, and cherries.
